scope: Fixed original Laya checkpoint and independently ported C# reference versus actual Sezika outputs. This version does not grant the historical real upstream Python evidence gate.

comparison.near_tie_handling: Report separately; a differing label/boolean remains a failed comparison. Do not widen tolerance after seeing measurements without creating a new version.
comparison.failure_comparison: Exact normalized stage/type; preserve upstream class/message as evidence. An observed failure is never an answered decision.
comparison.upstream_rounded_answer: Evidence only; upstream rounds to four decimals. Numerical comparison uses unrounded arrays.
comparison.missing_or_partial_cases: No full-suite pass; compare only explicitly selected IDs and record coverage.

evidence_policy: Reference values must be computed from independently ported frozen upstream source and original weights with complete source/build/runtime/process pins. upstream_executed, represents_parity, represents_quality and represents_calibration remain false. Reuse of actual numerical tensors or fabrication is prohibited. Original v1 upstream evidence remains separate.

port_reference_policy.source_independence: No production encoder/head/tokenizer or actual numeric payload reuse
